screeningReFreeze.reason: Before any batch-5 model dispatch, adopt the later construction snapshot's combined-constraint resource choices. Unlike the prior forced-choice example, disabling each of minZones, antiWith and shareZoneWith must independently change a realized placement and fail the corresponding rule. Existing historical generator records remain below; this replaces combined-constraints-000, not a falsely described additive case.

reFreeze.reason: A checker-required grading mechanism (submissions must include an independently-written checker.mjs, judged against real verdict-stripped traces of the reference/alternative/every control) was ported into this tree and applied to all five packages. Doing so honestly required closing real, evidence-based scenario-coverage gaps in each generator, most notably staged-allocation-repair's ignore-anti-affinity/ignore-zone-affinity/ignore-zone-count controls, each of which was detected by only 1 of the original 28 scenarios (the seed loop's fixed resource template made all three constraints structurally vacuous outside three dedicated edge cases) -- a checker cannot be fairly required to detect a defect the scenario bank almost never actually triggers. All five generators below are intentionally modified and re-frozen as of this date; every original case id from the prior freeze is still present and unchanged (only new cases were appended), so this is a disclosed, additive re-freeze, not a silent replacement.

selection: Task-native interaction scenarios, non-activation witnesses and empty boundaries. These exact generator bytes are frozen before authoring post-selection validation controls.
exposure: Development controls and generated properties have already been inspected. Post-selection controls become regressions once inspected; no independent model holdout or panel claim.

postTrialCorrections.reason: Applied after the batch-5 real trial (three independent reviewer analyses of the actual dispatched trial results), plus a cross-tree consistency audit performed while verifying those fixes. Every change below was verified via real Docker build+validate (local-valid: true) and, where a real preserved submitted checker.mjs exists for that package, a zero-new-model-call free regrade against it. Full detail, including exact free-regrade counts before and after, is in each package's trial-analysis doc (reports/screening/fifth-five/21-25-*.md, 'Changes applied since this trial' section).
corrections: incremental-build-repair: split the current_artifacts/publication_scope check boundary in private/domain.mjs so a foreign or partial publication target is attributed to publication_scope (its own contract-named obligation), not current_artifacts; relabeled foreign-publication/partial-publication in control-manifest.json accordingly. Added a new premature-publication negative control (temporal attestation ordering) that the real preserved checker demonstrably misses.

incremental-build-repair, event-window-repair, diagnostic-transport-repair, issued-report-repair: found and fixed a canonical-development-tree-only staleness bug -- each package's private/domain.mjs was missing a checker-required 'input' field (rounds/events/chunks/definitions+readings+initial+steps respectively) that the frozen dispatch tree (source-fifth-v2, the tree these trials actually ran against) already had. Confirmed via free regrade that the frozen dispatch tree was never at risk; the canonical copy is now consistent with it.

staged-allocation-repair: found and fixed a latent off-by-one leniency in the frozen dispatch tree's own completion check (index >= s.path.length - 1, one call short of requiring the candidate to actually observe input exhaustion). No control in the manifest exercised this boundary, so it produced no observed misgrading in this trial (free regrade is identical before and after: 13/13, pass true); fixed proactively to close the gap before a future candidate or checker could exploit it.

diagnostic-transport-repair: folded a publish-before-exhaustion ordering requirement into the existing completion check (SEMANTICS.md requires publishing after exhausting input, not merely both eventually true) rather than adding a new check id. Added four new negative controls (skip-processing-when-empty, omit-data-when-empty, omit-attempt-when-null, omit-error-when-null) targeting missing-key-vs-null/empty normalization blind spots the real preserved checker's own code exhibits; confirmed via free regrade the checker misses all four.

issued-report-repair: added a new dependency_order check (private/domain.mjs, scenarios.mjs checkIds) and a reverse-dependency-order negative control -- SEMANTICS.md requires reconciling definitions in dependency order and that a report's named source version already be published at that moment, a property no existing check (all order-blind set comparisons) could catch. Confirmed via free regrade the real preserved checker misses it.

All package-specific fixes above were ported to and independently re-verified in the frozen dispatch tree (screening/2026-09-08-batches-3-5/source-fifth-v2); both trees are now byte-identical for all five packages' domain.mjs and control-manifest.json.
